# infisical_pam_account_aws_iam (Resource)

Create and manage AWS IAM accounts in Infisical PAM. The connection is tested when the account is created or its connection changes. The test assumes `role_arn`, so the role must trust Infisical before the account is created. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder" "cloud" {
  name = "cloud"
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_template" "aws" {
  name         = "aws-console"
  account_type = "aws-iam"

  policies = {
    max_session_duration = 3600
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_aws_iam" "billing" {
  name        = "billing-read-only"
  folder_id   = infisical_pam_folder.cloud.id
  template_id = infisical_pam_account_template.aws.id

  connection_details = {
    # The role's trust policy must allow Infisical, with your organization ID as the external ID.
    role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infisical-pam-billing"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_details` (Attributes) How to reach the AWS IAM target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_details))
- `folder_id` (String) The ID of the folder the account is in. Changing it moves the account.
- `name` (String) The name of the account, unique in its folder. Must be lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, at most 64 characters.
- `template_id` (String) The ID of the account template the account uses, which must be a `aws-iam` template.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the account.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the gateway to connect through instead of the template's.
- `gateway_pool_id` (String) The ID of the gateway pool to connect through instead of the template's.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the account.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_details`

Required:

- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role Infisical assumes to give access to the account. Its trust policy must allow Infisical, with your organization ID as the external ID. See [AWS IAM accounts](https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pam/accounts/aws-iam) for the trust policy to use.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the AWS IAM PAM account by its ID
terraform import infisical_pam_account_aws_iam.example <account_id>
```
